S1 at d05e5b28: new crossProject phrfComparison (deps fit, model, upickle).
- Strict STORED npz/npy reader with 18 typed errors.
- PhrfDatasetBinding binds schema, root, denylist, code hash, cell spec, npz and per-array sha/dtype/shape.
- FitInputs/ScoreTruth split with private constructors.
- Portable SHA-256 checked against FIPS vectors.
- JVM 39/39, JS 29/29, CompileAll clean.
- Fixed a Double.toString JVM/JS defect in an error message.
Deviation flagged for review: manifest stream seeds (>2^53) are not bound; they must be parsed exactly for provenance. Independent review in progress.
